== Discord names (30 December 2023) ==

On 30 December 2023, largeporg wrote "FRODO WINS THE IRL RETRO EVENT" ([https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1184342427205648455/1190462661792628827 Discord, 30 December 2023]) and named SWCCG2Moon the GEMP Retro and Final Confrontation winner ([https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1184342427205648455/1190602635661815828 Discord, 30 December 2023]). The article, citing the Players Committee recap, says [[Brian Avery]] won in person and [[Will Tarbox]] won the GEMP event and the Final Confrontation. This does not identify Frodo with [[Brian Avery]], or SWCCG2Moon with [[Will Tarbox]].
